pois.name: Hose 5 Fire Museum
pois.intro: Bangor Hose House No. 5, is an historic fire station at 247 State Street in Bangor, Maine.

pois.name: Thomas Hill Standpipe
pois.intro: Thomas Hill Standpipe, which holds 1,750,000 US gallons of water, is a riveted wrought iron tank with a wood frame jacket located on Thomas Hill in Bangor, Maine, United States. The metal tank is 50 feet high and 75 feet in diameter.
